description: Cities in Europe and Central Asia : A Shifting Story of Urban Growth and Decline Database is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Policies and plans", published or maintained by World Bank Group. This research, designed by the World Bank, and supported by the Department for International Development (DFID), aims to describe the transformation of the urban systems in the ECA region in the last decades, and to look at this shifts from the demographic, economic, and spatial prospectives. Coverage: 13 countries in Europe and Central Asia. It has 4 files in XLS, STATA, PDF. The portal files it under Policies and plans. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
